audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill for levels 2, 3 and 4-5 while their whys say Sylas out-trades and out-sustains there, gave Sylas level 6 where the why calls it your one clean kill window, and gave Skill at 2+ items where the why says he out-scales hard.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Skill, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Nautilus, Sylas, Sylas — and Depth Charge is point-click, so his dash cannot answer level 6.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Nautilus, Sylas, Sylas with ratings to match.

audit.why: Spikes: levels 2-3 lockdown trade, level 6 Depth Charge, his level 6 Hijack, first item his sustain. Hijack's 80/55/30s is the spike that matters — at rank 3 he has it back every 30 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The healing is repeatedly attributed to his Q ('his Q drain', 'drain Q'). Chain Lash (Q, 775, 6-10s) only damages and slows with a delayed explosion; the heal is Kingslayer (W, 400 range, 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s), which is also a lunge.
audit.why: Riot text: Kingslayer 'lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions'. Abscond (E, 400, 13-9s) dashes and recasts to pull him to an enemy hit.
audit.corrected: Track Kingslayer's 6-12s for his sustain and Abscond's 9-13s for his mobility; Grievous Wounds is what decides extended trades. Hijack (80/55/30s) turns your own Depth Charge back on you, so never open with R while it is up.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — you both lack your combo, but your passive root makes auto-trades favorable if he steps up to last-hit. The problem starts once he has E: his chain-dash both dodges your Q anchor and is his disengage, so a missed Q means he dashes onto you for a stun and Q-drains the trade back. Throw Q only when his E is on cooldown or he's pinned against a wall, and farm with E waves rather than face-checking trades you can't sustain through.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — you both lack your combo, but your passive root makes auto-trades favorable if he steps up to last-hit. The problem starts once he has Abscond: the dash dodges your anchor and doubles as disengage, and its recast pulls him back onto you while Kingslayer heals the trade back. Throw Q only on Abscond's 9-13s cooldown or when he is pinned against a wall, and farm with E waves rather than face-checking trades you cannot sustain.

edits.before: This is his window and you have to respect it. His Q drain plus W heal out-sustain your W-burn chip in any extended trade, and he has two stun-dashes on E to your single Q. Your one real spike is Level 6: Depth Charge is homing and undodgeable, so his E cannot dash out of it — combo R into Q-pull, passive root, E slow and you can kill him. But watch his ult: if his R is up he steals your Depth Charge and fires it back, so only commit when you've baited his R out or it's on cooldown.
edits.after: This is his window and you have to respect it. Kingslayer heals him off you every 6-12 seconds and out-sustains your W-burn chip in any extended trade, and Abscond recasts into a chain pull. Your one real spike is Level 6: Depth Charge is homing and undodgeable, so his dash cannot leave it — combo R into Q-pull, passive root, E slow and you can kill him. But watch Hijack: with it up he steals your Depth Charge and fires it back, and at rank 3 it returns every 30s.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Abscond is a 9-13s dash; the recast chains him back to you. Commit once it is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals off you — Grievous Wounds before any long trade.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Hook + passive root chain.
edits.after: Abscond is a 9-13s dash that recasts into a chain pull — hook and passive-root him once it is spent, and never ult into an up Hijack.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond: 9-13s dash, and the recast pulls him back to you. Bait it, then commit. - Hijack: 80/55/30s — he steals and casts YOUR Depth Charge back at you. - Depth Charge: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: UNVERIFIED, left in place rather than restated: the existing claim that Abscond's recast stuns ('two stun-dashes', 'dash + stun'). Riot's text says only that it pulls him to an enemy he hits and the kit carries no hardCC flag on E, so I neither asserted nor denied a stun — my rewrites describe it as a chain pull.
